bio.text: Vince Fong was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives on May 21, 2024, and represents California's 20th Congressional District, which includes parts of Fresno, Kern, Kings, and Tulare counties.
Born in Bakersfield, he began his career on the staff of Rep. Bill Thomas and later served for nearly a decade as district director to Rep. Kevin McCarthy.
He was elected to the California State Assembly in 2016 and served there until 2024.
He earned a bachelor's degree from UCLA and a master's degree from Princeton University.
